summary.text: Jonathan Bingle is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 6-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Julia Payne.
He served on the Spokane City Council, District 1 Position 2, from 2022 to 2025 and is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Bingle was born in Spokane, attended John R. Rogers High School and Spokane Falls Community College, and lives in Spokane.

In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a small business owner, former pastor and father of three who helped plant and pastor a church on Spokane's Northside, built an events business with his wife, and worked in youth and community development.
Bingle assumed office on the Spokane City Council on January 1, 2022, and left office in 2025.
He finished first in the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary for this seat, with 50.6 percent of the vote.
In the 2025 survey, he listed keeping Spokane clean and safe, building more housing while respecting neighborhood character, and supporting jobs and lower taxes and fees among his key messages.
